strings.name: Lee Jae-myung
strings.summary: A former teenage factory worker, Lee became a lawyer, Seongnam mayor, Gyeonggi governor, legislator and Democratic Party leader. He won the 2025 election following Yoon Suk Yeol’s removal and became president, emphasizing distribution and living standards. His pre-presidency criminal cases remain contested: as of November 2026 all five trials were on hold, rather than concluded with acquittals.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His rise from local government to national leadership brought influence on distribution, administrative reform and democratic institutions.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace and birth record
strings.facts.f1.value: Andong, South Korea; officially registered as 22 December 1964, with biographical accounts suggesting a 1963 birth.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Law bachelor’s, Chung-Ang University; judicial examination in 1986 and judicial training completed in 1989.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Local to national government
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from labor-related legal practice into local administration and the presidency.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Welfare and institutions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Redistribution proposals and continuing judicial disputes shape his political career.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Trials remain suspended
strings.timeline.t1.text: Reporting confirmed all five criminal trials remained on hold amid debate over withdrawing charges.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Meets Timor-Leste president
strings.timeline.t2.text: Discussed diplomacy, economic and development cooperation with José Ramos-Horta.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes president
strings.timeline.t3.text: Began his term after winning the early presidential election.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Election-law case remanded
strings.timeline.t4.text: Supreme Court overturned the appeal court’s acquittal and returned the case for further proceedings.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Enters parliament and leads party
strings.timeline.t5.text: Elected legislator and became Democratic Party leader that year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Gyeonggi governor
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from Seongnam to provincial leadership.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Seongnam mayor
strings.timeline.t7.text: Began two mayoral terms, ending in 2018.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes law studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned a Chung-Ang degree and passed the national judicial examination.
